# Income Tax Calculator

> US income tax calculator covering federal, state and city taxes, including local income and payroll taxes most calculators leave out. Everything on the site is also available from a free JSON API, with no API key, and through an MCP server.

The web pages work out their results in the browser with JavaScript, so fetching a calculator page returns no figures. Use the API below instead.

## JSON API

- [calculate](https://income-tax.org/api/calculate?income=120000&state=new_york&city=new_york_city): take-home pay and every tax for an annual gross income. Required: `income`, `state`. Optional: `city`, `year`, `filing_status` (single, married, married_separately, head_of_household), `retirement_contribution` (pre-tax 401(k)/IRA dollars), `federal_deductions`, `state_deductions` (default: standard deduction), `exempt_taxes` (comma-separated `scope:tax`), `pay_frequency` (weekly, biweekly, semi_monthly, monthly).
- [target](https://income-tax.org/api/target?take_home=6000&target_period=monthly&state=texas): the gross income needed for a take-home goal. Required: `take_home`, `state`. `target_period` is annual (default) or a pay frequency. Accepts the same optional parameters as calculate.
- [tax_tables](https://income-tax.org/api/tax-tables?state=oregon&city=portland&filing_status=single): brackets, rates, standard deductions and the 401(k) limit. All optional: `year`, `state` (omit for federal only), `city`, `filing_status`, `tax_types` (comma-separated).

States and cities are snake_case (`new_york`, `new_york_city`). Invalid input returns HTTP 400 with the valid values. Amounts are US dollars per year unless labelled per paycheck.

- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://income-tax.org/openapi.json): all three endpoints, for agent frameworks and ChatGPT GPT Actions.

## MCP server

- [MCP endpoint](https://income-tax.org/mcp): Streamable HTTP, no authentication. The same three endpoints as tools: `calculate`, `target`, `tax_tables`. Use it where you cannot fetch a URL you build yourself.

## Docs

- [API & MCP documentation](https://income-tax.org/developers/): every parameter, with defaults.
- [Disclaimer](https://income-tax.org/disclaimer/): results are estimates for a single wage earner, not tax advice.

## Optional

- [Tax tables](https://income-tax.org/tax-tables/): browsable federal, state and city tax tables.
- [Cities with income taxes](https://income-tax.org/city-taxes/): every city and county with its own taxes.
